_note: Illustrative values only. A real project derives them from its own hazard analysis and FTTI (see safety/ftti_sheet in the report).
name: default (on-road, 40 km/h ODD)

dynamic._note: Used when model = dynamic (run.py --plant dynamic). Illustrative: a mid-size vehicle, not a calibrated one.

dut_hw._note: v2.9.7: a real reset of the ESP32-S3 safety controller (EN pin) gives its first SAF_Status after 185-187 ms (measured, 5 resets). DUTs that can't really reset emulate it as a power loss this long.

known_findings.bv_steer_rate_40kmh_16dps: At 40 km/h the 26 m stop drifts ~1.0 m sideways: the safety controller holds heading but has no lane information. Options: follow the planner's last valid path, or a higher stop deceleration at speed.
